due_when.clears_when: scripts/backtest_orb.py imports execution_costs and applies a slippage term (in points, unit-reconciled) in addition to FEE_POINTS_ROUNDTRIP.

what: checklist E3 (cost model reaching every harness): scripts/backtest_orb.py has NO slippage model and was never wired to execution_costs.py. Its fee is modelled in POINTS round-trip (FEE_POINTS_ROUNDTRIP=0.5), not bps -- a deliberate, venue-correct choice for index futures -- but that means execution_costs.roundtrip_cost_r cannot be reused as-is (it assumes a bps-of-notional fee/slippage term). E3 wired the 6 harnesses that had literally zero cost terms (chop_scalp, funding_carry, fvg_range, pairs, xsec_momentum, vwap) plus confirmed the 6 harnesses already wired to execution_costs (fade, ict_scalp, pullback, squeeze, system, trend) resolve slippage/funding via the venue-aware CLI default already. orb.py was NOT wired: it needs a points-vs-bps unit reconciliation (execution_costs.slippage_bps_roundtrip_for(symbol) converted to points via the traded contract's tick/point value) before a slippage term can be added without fabricating a wrong-unit cost.
